title: Common
description: Shared definitions referenced by every other Cogitato schema.

schemaVersion.title: SchemaVersion
schemaVersion.description: Version of the file format. Bumped on breaking changes.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Lowercase words joined by dashes, e.g. "card-declined".
slug.x-hint: Use lowercase words joined by dashes, like "card-declined".

screenId.title: ScreenId
screenId.description: Dot-separated lowercase id of a screen, e.g. "checkout.payment".
screenId.x-hint: Screen ids are lowercase words separated by dots, like "checkout.payment".

kitId.title: KitId
kitId.x-hint: Element ids are the screen id plus an element name, lowercase and dot-separated, like "checkout.payment.submit".

nodeRef.title: NodeRef
nodeRef.description: Reference to one state of one screen: {screenId}.{stateId}, e.g. "checkout.payment.card-declined".
nodeRef.x-hint: A flow step is a screen id plus a state id, like "checkout.payment.card-declined".

commit.title: CommitSha
commit.description: Git commit sha, short or full.
commit.x-hint: This should be a git commit id: 7 to 40 characters of 0-9 and a-f.

frameStatus.title: FrameStatus
frameStatus.description: Review status of a frame on the canvas.
